hero.description: Find and connect with professional workers in your area instantly, or post your job requirements with descriptions and photos. Connect directly via phone number with zero in-app payments or fees.

features.section_title: Find Nearby Workers, Direct Hiring, Simple Coordination
features.section_description: Browse and connect with workers in your area, or post custom requirements with photos. Registered workers can accept requests and view client contact details to connect directly, with zero commissions or in-app fees.
features.card1_description: Browse and search active, skilled workers directly in your area. Contact the right experts for your immediate home or commercial needs.
features.card2_description: Can't find a worker? Easily post your specific requirements with photos and descriptions. Nearby experts will see and accept your request.
features.card3_description: Workers log in to accept or reject requests. Upon acceptance, they get the client's phone number to coordinate directly. No in-app payment required!
